decisions.reason: The ceiling or floor pipe bracket is a simple, low-cost extension of the core pipeline offer in a growing industry, and with no visible shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search to redirect its resources.

The pipe support bracket fits the established infrastructure range and uses existing fabrication and coating capabilities at little extra cost, so slack allows it to be carried even though its results are uncertain.

The powder-coated public waste bin is distant from the core business and its later results are unobserved, but it serves the same municipal customers and uses the coating equipment, so management would likely keep it unless it clearly falls short of aspirations.

The waste bin line with ashtray shares production and customers with the other street furniture products, and as a multi-model line it represents a deliberate diversification that slack from a growing market lets the firm continue to test.

The outdoor public ashtrays are the most peripheral to pipeline work and the most exposed to a refocus if aspirations are missed, but without evidence of a shortfall the firm would likely keep them as part of its municipal street furniture line.
